video_title_guess: How Bronny Lit a New Fire for LeBron in Year 23

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on Bronny's presence as motivation to be a professional
quotes.quote: I think it's definitely the sport and it's the, I have the ability to still inspire and I have the ability to still play this game at a high level. And I still love the process. To be able to have Bronny in the locker room has definitely helped out a lot as well. I have a job and a responsibility to show him what it means to be a professional. Yes, he's seen it from the outside looking in throughout the course of his life, but now being in the locker room, being in film sessions, being on the plane, being everything that surrounds how to be a professional and the results that come with it. I have a responsibility. So, those are a couple ways for me and a couple ways that's given me inspiration and given me motivation to still do this.
